lesson.title: Zitoun and the Flying Page
beat.cover.title: Zitoun and the Flying Page
beat.cover.narration: Zitoun and the Flying Page. [[about]]A story about a little fox who loves to read.
node.tc.title: Zitoun and the Flying Page
node.tc.lines.0: A story about a little fox who loves to read
beat.p1.title: The village
beat.p1.narration: In a white village by the sea, there lived a little fox called Zitoun. [[love]]Zitoun loved books more than anything else in the world.
node.pg1.alt: A little fox reading a book in a white village with blue doors
beat.p2.title: The argan tree
beat.p2.narration: Every morning, he sat under the big argan tree and read. [[shade]]Its branches kept him safe from the hot summer sun.
node.pg2.alt: The fox reading in the shade of a big argan tree, under the sun
beat.p3.title: The wind
beat.p3.narration: One day, a strong wind blew, and a page flew out of his book! [[run]]Zitoun ran after it, past the market, all the way to the beach.
node.pg3.alt: A page flying in the wind and the fox running toward the sea
beat.p4.title: Nour
beat.p4.narration: There he found a little goat called Nour, happily reading his page. [[say]]Zitoun said, “Let’s read together!” [[friends]]And from that day on, Zitoun had a friend who loved books just as much as he did.
node.pg4.alt: The fox and a little goat on the beach, with a page and a heart between them
beat.q1.title: A little question
beat.q1.narration: A little question. Where did Zitoun read every morning?
q.where.prompt: Where did Zitoun read every morning?
q.where.explain: Every morning, Zitoun read under the big argan tree.
q.where.options.b.why: Zitoun only went to the beach on the windy day.
q.where.options.c.why: Zitoun only ran past the market while chasing the page.
beat.finish.title: The end
beat.finish.narration: Well done! That is the end of the story.
